description_en: Submits a repair task of risk items detected in configuration assessment or rolls back a repair task that is executed
description_zh: 云产品配置检查中提交存在风险检查项的修复任务或回滚已经执行的修复任务
name: SubmitOperationTask

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the check item.

You can call the [ListCheckResult](~~ListCheckResult~~) operation to obtain the ID of the check item
parameters.help_zh:
检查项的ID。

您可调用[ListCheckResult](~~ListCheckResult~~)接口获取检查项ID
parameters.name: check_id

fields.help_en: The instance ID of the server
fields.name: instance_id

fields.help_en: The region ID of the server
fields.name: region_id

fields.help_en: The ID of the task that you want to roll back
fields.help_zh: 回滚任务时回滚的任务ID
fields.name: task_id

fields.help_en:
The service provider of the asset. Valid values:

0: an asset provided by Alibaba Cloud.
1: an asset outside Alibaba Cloud.
2: an asset in a data center.
3, 4, 5, and 7: an asset from a third-party cloud service provider.
8: a lightweight asset
fields.help_zh:
资产厂商。取值：

0：阿里云资产
1：云外资产
2：IDC资产
3、4、5、7：其它云资产
8：轻量级资产
fields.name: vendor

parameters.help_en: The asset information required to submit the tasks for instances
parameters.help_zh: 提交实例任务所需的资产信息
parameters.name: operation_task_instances

parameters.help_en:
The dimension of the task that you want to submit. Valid values:

Instance dimension: INSTANCE
Check item dimension: CHECK_ID
parameters.help_zh:
提交操作任务的任务维度：
实例维度：INSTANCE
检查项维度：CHECK_ID
parameters.name: dimension_type

parameters.help_en:
The type of the task that you want to submit. Valid values:

Repair task: REPAIR
Rollback task: ROLLBACK
parameters.help_zh:
提交任务的任务类型：
修复任务：REPAIR
回滚任务：ROLLBACK
parameters.name: type

fields.help_en: The name of the temporary repair parameter
fields.help_zh: 对应临时修复参数的名称
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: The value of the temporary repair parameter
fields.help_zh: 临时修复参数对应的值
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The temporary parameters required for the repair task
parameters.help_zh: 修复任务需要的临时参数
parameters.name: repair_temp_param

parameters.help_en:
The key linked to cross-page selections during task submission.

You can call the [CreateAssetSelectionConfig](~~CreateAssetSelectionConfig~~) operation to query the associated key from the BusinessType field
parameters.help_zh:
提交操作时关联跨页选择的关联Key。
您可调用[CreateAssetSelectionConfig](~~CreateAssetSelectionConfig~~)接口BusinessType字段获取关联Key
parameters.name: relation_key

OperateCode.description_en:
The handling result code. Valid values:

Insufficient authorization: AuthorizationExhaust
Unauthorized: ActionTrialUnauthorized
OperateCode.description_zh:
处理返回的结果码：
授权不足：AuthorizationExhaust
未授权：ActionTrialUnauthorized

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

RootTaskId.description_en: The main task ID that is returned when the task is submitted
RootTaskId.description_zh: 提交任务返回的主任务ID
